Myth and fact

Can Git history replace the handbook?

“The repository contains the whole history, so we do not need to maintain a guide.” How would you respond?

Source and scope

Git Discovery · M15, “A Git repository documents every editorial decision.”

Recognising a faulty inference

What does Emre’s finding establish?

Emre has just joined the project and is reading its documentation. A useful first guide is the README file, which usually explains a repository’s purpose, contents and use. Here it names a program for importing data. Emre compares these instructions with the current automated processing workflow, the pipeline.

The guide names import-v1.py. The pipeline now uses import-v2.py, a different version of the import program. What does this establish?

Source and scope

Git Antipattern Academy · E2, “Git as the all-knowing witness”; Emre’s import finding.
